name: Ollama (local)
_transportNote: The first provider that is not a web page. No selectors, no completion heuristics, no login, no rate limit - and the conversation is ours, so nothing can virtualise or redesign it. Chat only for now: plan and build refuse this transport, because a small local model failing the strict JSON format would read as CloseNI being broken rather than the model being too small.
_modelNote: Matched on the part before the colon, so this finds qwen2.5-coder:7b - the same way `ollama run` does. Change it to whatever `ollama list` shows.
_timeoutNote: Generous on purpose. A 7B model on a CPU takes minutes for a long answer, and cutting it off would report a working setup as broken.
_selectorsNote: Empty and unused - this provider never opens a page. Present only because ProviderConfig requires the shape; the selector health check skips a provider whose transport is not a browser.
_contextBudgetNote: Roughly how much conversation this provider will hold before a build should continue in a new thread, in characters. A deliberately conservative guess - nothing can read the real window, and being wrong in this direction costs one seeded prompt while being wrong the other way loses a step fifteen deep. Counted from what we send and the replies we receive, never from the page.
